answer: An agent economy can require each identity to hold a real part-time job with payroll reported to the tax authority, which splits a farm's aliases like a prism into accountable taxpayers. A quartz timer allows one payroll enrollment per funding trail per month, blocking parallel hiring. Each extra fake needs a new real employer, weeks of onboarding, and a compliance bond in outside money that doubles every time. At dawn each month the roster publishes; duplicates face fraud liability, so each additional fake costs another employer, another month, and twice the prior bond.
